grains.RAW.CORRIDORS: one row per inbound remittance corridor (send market into a Philippine payout city)
grains.RAW.CORRIDOR_DAILY: one row per corridor per day (90 days)
grains.RAW.DUE_DILIGENCE_DOCUMENTS: one row per corridor (payout-partner due-diligence document snapshot)

freshness: MAX(EVENT_DATE) is an observation watermark; requestedAt is not freshness

required_capabilities.core_pipeline: Curated KPIs reconcile to a RAW recomputation (run_core.py checks this on every build)
required_capabilities.failure_risk_model: Snowflake ML CLASSIFICATION of P(failed transfer on the corridor in the next 7 days), evaluated on an out-of-time holdout
required_capabilities.forecast_and_anomaly: 14-day operator-wide exception-volume FORECAST; screening hit rate ANOMALY_DETECTION (train 75 days, detect last 15)
required_capabilities.search: Cortex Search SEARCH.EXCEPTION_SOP_SEARCH over synthetic remittance exception-handling SOPs (one per send market and exception type)
required_capabilities.semantic_analytics: Semantic view APP.REMITTANCE_ANALYTICS and Cortex Agent APP.REMITTANCE_AGENT using analyst + search tools
required_capabilities.grounded_ai: Agent answers return generated SQL and SOP citations; the action memo uses only KPI, corridor, exception-type and risk rows
required_capabilities.quicksight: DIRECT_QUERY dashboard (corridors, daily exceptions, failed transfers by corridor, failed-transfer risk, transfer events loaded) through a read-only Snowflake service user
required_capabilities.quicksight_q: Amazon Q topic over the curated datasets for natural-language questions
required_capabilities.aws_ingestion: Amazon Data Firehose -> S3 -> Snowpipe AUTO_INGEST into RAW.LIVE_TRANSFERS
required_capabilities.notifications: APP.LIVE_TRANSFER_ALERT logs new EXCEPTION events to APP.ALERT_LOG and emails via SYSTEM$SEND_EMAIL; alert and tasks suspended between demos
required_capabilities.orchestration: Task graph APP.TASK_REFRESH_CURATED -> APP.TASK_RESCORE_RISK run on demand (EXECUTE TASK)

aws.memo: Amazon Bedrock Claude Sonnet 4.5 via APP.BEDROCK_GENERATE
